疑为: After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A, B, C, and D.
理由: 第 6、7 句本是一句，被句号从中间切断；翻译按一句的意思分两半译。

原: Is also a common characteristic, right?
疑为: (…to be the best of the best) is also a common characteristic, right?
理由: 缺主语，应与上一句末尾的 a burning desire to be the best of the best 连成一句；译作“这也是一个共同特点，对吧？”。

原: While it has long been a practice in Asian countries.
疑为: While it has long been a practice in Asian countries, many people in Western countries have yet to embrace …
理由: 让步从句被句号与主句（第 117 句）切开。

原: After all, they may think a little dirt doesn’t hurt anyone, but.
疑为: After all, they may think a little dirt doesn’t hurt anyone, but I can give you several good reasons …
理由: but 后被句号切断，应与第 120 句连读。

原: Most of the time, the rational part of the mind controls the information coming from the primitive.
疑为: … coming from the primitive core and makes its own decisions …
理由: 句号切在 primitive 与 core 之间，第 155 句开头的 core 属于本句。

原: The big exception is China, where spending has far.
疑为: The big exception is China, where spending has far surpassed other countries over the past decade. China seems set to …
理由: 句号切在 far 与 Surpassed 之间；第 191 句的逗号处才是句界。

原: … a humanitarian responsibility too, caused by scientists for large increases …
疑为: … a humanitarian responsibility too, so calls by scientists for large increases …
理由: caused 应为 calls（转写错误），否则句子不通；翻译按“科学家呼吁大幅增加拨款……是完全合理的”译。
